_about: The faction catalogue import (verify/from-bsdata.js chaos-daemons) reads BSData's whole Chaos Daemons catalogue (and the Daemons Library it imports root entries from) through verify/from-json.js as the export catalog-chaos-daemons; this is its hand file. weaponNames: a weapon BSData names otherwise than GW's datasheet (Wahapedia), so that GW's profile is found and its values checked; the app keeps BSData's name (New Recruit's, which the lists' signed-off rows and the in-app import use).
